description: Kelly Kirschner condemned President Donald Trump’s illegal use of taxpayer money for political propaganda promoting himself and called on his opponent, Sydney Gruters, to reject the corrupt misuse of public power for private gain, including her husband’s – Joe Gruters, RNC Chair.
title: Even Republican Senators Reject Trump’s Taxpayer Funded Ads. Does Congressional Candidate Sydney Gruters? - Kelly Kirschner for U.S. Congress - FL 16
